name: @project-vyasa/sa-wikisource-org
description: Project Vyasa data pipeline and publication for Sanskrit Wikisource texts (Rig Veda, Aṣṭādhyāyī, Taittirīya family)

scripts.pipeline:rv: bun run crawl:rv && bun run extract:rv && bun run transform:rv && bun run enrich:rv && bun run verify:rv
scripts.build:rv: vyasac pack data/processed/rigveda && vyasac publish data/processed/rigveda
scripts.build:aady: vyasac pack data/processed/ashtadhyayi && vyasac publish data/processed/ashtadhyayi
scripts.build:tts: vyasac pack data/processed/taittiriya-samhita && vyasac publish data/processed/taittiriya-samhita
scripts.build:tta: vyasac pack data/processed/taittiriya-aranyaka && vyasac publish data/processed/taittiriya-aranyaka
scripts.build:ttb: vyasac pack data/processed/taittiriya-brahmana && vyasac publish data/processed/taittiriya-brahmana
scripts.build:ttpr: vyasac pack data/processed/taittiriya-pratisakhya && vyasac publish data/processed/taittiriya-pratisakhya
scripts.pipeline:tta: bun run crawl:tta && bun run extract:tta && bun run transform:tta && bun run verify:tta
scripts.pipeline:ttb: bun run crawl:ttb && bun run extract:ttb && bun run transform:ttb && bun run verify:ttb
scripts.pipeline:ttpr: bun run crawl:ttpr && bun run extract:ttpr && bun run transform:ttpr && bun run verify:ttpr
